issues.title: Capture detail expand/collapse in `material-table`
issues.body:
For the `Orders` and `Adjudication` tables, I wish to show the relevant orders when a detail panel is expanded, and hide it again when it is collapsed.

@lebaphi managed to extract the currently filtered rows, hopefully he can get into the code again and make the material-table call a callback when a row is expanded or collapsed.
